reason: E1 supports strain-induced amorphization in HEAs at ~10% strain and its link to local inhomogeneity, but was performed at room temperature, not 600–1000°C. E2 confirms BCC stability and elastic behavior up to 900°C but reports no amorphization or enhanced lattice distortions at temperature. The premise that thermal expansion amplifies distortions to trigger amorphization is not directly evidenced by either citation.
premises: Elastic strain-induced amorphization occurs in HEAs at ~10% strain
Amorphization is linked to depressed dislocation nucleation from local atomic inhomogeneity
